dedupe_keys.name: random forest atmospheric neutral density model

description: RANDM applies a random forest to estimate neutral-atmosphere density at a specified orbital altitude. Its output can inform satellite-drag studies when the required geomagnetic and location variables are available. The resource is documented by NASA GSFC. The documented physical domain is Thermosphere; grid spacing, supported periods and cadence depend on this version and its chosen configuration. The documentation links Public Repository. A software licence and any external distribution charge are not stated. The documented prediction altitude is 400 kilometres; extrapolation to other altitudes is not established. The documented space-weather effects make it a potential environmental input for infrastructure hazard exposure and resilience simulations. It is related to platform-nasa-ccmc in this catalogue. Spatial and temporal resolution were not independently established. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
